description: This Java class 'MongoDbUriSupplier' provides functionality to generate a MongoDB URI with additional options specified via configuration. It validates, parses, and enhances a base URI with query parameters, supporting features like encoding and merging connection options. The class is used within the context of configuration-driven MongoDB connection management.

classes.name: MongoDbUriSupplier
classes.description: Main class that supplies and constructs MongoDB connection URIs based on configuration, with support for adding and encoding options.

classes.name: MongoDbUriEnhancer
classes.description: Inner class that extends a given MongoDB URI by appending connection options from configuration, encoding query parameters properly.

classes.name: QueryComponentParser
classes.description: Inner singleton class that parses the query component of a URI into a map of key-value pairs.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of MongoDbUriSupplier from a Config object, validating the config and extracting the URI.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the URI string, potentially enhanced with additional options as per configuration.

methods.name: tryToCreateMongoDbTargetUri
methods.description: Constructs the target URI, catching and wrapping syntax errors.

methods.name: createMongoDbTargetUri
methods.description: Constructs a new URI based on the source URI, adding query options.
